entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: An Otarian barbarian, sister of Kamahl, who became a planeswalker and sacrificed her life and spark to close the rifts and begin the Mending.

entities.name: Phage the Untouchable
entities.description: A cursed avatar born from Jeska, whose touch rots organic things, who served the Cabal Patriarch and dissolved into Karona.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Jeska's brother, who went berserk under the Mirari's influence and wounded her, and who welcomed her in death.

entities.name: Balthor Rockfist
entities.description: Leader of the tribe Jeska grew up in.

entities.name: Seton
entities.description: A centaur who was left to care for the dying Jeska.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: Who captured Jeska and brought her to the Cabal Patriarch.

entities.name: Cabal Patriarch
entities.description: The Cabal leader whose attempt to destroy Jeska created Phage; Phage bore him a child.

entities.name: Ixidor
entities.description: The ruler of Topos whose dream magic sent deathwurms out of Phage; consumed by the wurm holding Nivea.

entities.name: Nivea
entities.description: Ixidor's love, Phage's first kill.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: An angel who lost her legs fighting in the Grand Coliseum and later tracked Phage for killing Nivea.

entities.name: Zagorka
entities.description: A woman who joined Phage in Sanctum and was accidentally slain by Kamahl.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: The goddess of magic formed from the essence of Akroma, Phage and Zagorka; the Otarian rift was a result of her birth and death.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Jeska's mentor among the planeswalkers.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker working to close the temporal rifts whom Jeska clashes with.

entities.name: Leshrac Nightwalker
entities.description: A planeswalker who manipulated Jeska, stripped her of her Phage legacy, and was defeated by Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon who freed Jeska and told her the Otarian rift was too immense to close.

entities.name: Radha
entities.description: A companion whom Jeska took as a mana lens and who stood with her at the end.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: The forest avatar of Yavimaya whose physical form Jeska immolated.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A planeswalker who stood by Jeska at the Otarian rift.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: A powerful artifact whose influence drove Kamahl berserk and which killed Karona.

entities.name: Mask of Night's Reach
entities.description: An artifact Leshrac used to strip Jeska of her Phage legacy.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: The organization led by the Patriarch that Phage served.

entities.name: Grand Coliseum
entities.description: The arena Phage built where Kamahl, Phage and Akroma fought.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Region whose skies held the last rift.

entities.name: The Mending
entities.description: The healing of all rifts begun by Jeska's sacrifice.

events.summary: Under the Mirari's influence Kamahl goes berserk, slaying most of his kin and dealing Jeska a horrific blow.
events.quote: Kamahl lost control and went berserk, slaying most of his kin and striking a horrific blow against Jeska

events.summary: Braids captures the dying Jeska and brings her to the Cabal Patriarch.
events.quote: she ultimately was captured by Braids and brought to the Cabal Patriarch

events.summary: The Patriarch's attempt to destroy Jeska instead gives birth to Phage the Untouchable.
events.quote: attempt to destroy Jeska instead gave birth to Phage the Untouchable

events.summary: Phage builds the Grand Coliseum.
events.quote: She built the Grand Coliseum

events.summary: Kamahl, Phage and Akroma fight in the Grand Coliseum; Akroma loses her legs and Kamahl wins.
events.quote: After a three-way bout with Kamahl and Akroma in the Grand Coliseum

events.summary: Ixidor's dream magic sends the deathwurms out of Phage, leaving her Jeska again.
events.quote: those deathwurms were sent out into the world, leaving her once again Jeska

events.summary: To save the land Jeska pulls the deathwurms back into herself, damning herself to life as Phage.
events.quote: she pulled them back into herself, damning herself to a life as Phage

events.summary: The surviving wurm containing Nivea consumes Ixidor so he can rest with his love.
events.quote: that wurm consumed Ixidor, so he could rest with his love forever

events.summary: Kamahl's Soul Reaper kills Akroma and Phage and accidentally Zagorka, their essences forming Karona.
events.quote: The essence of the three women blended into a new being

events.summary: When Karona is killed the three women separate and Jeska's spark ignites, making her a planeswalker.
events.quote: the three women separated

events.summary: During the temporal crisis Jeska appears on Dominaria searching for Karn.
events.quote: Jeska appeared on Dominaria while searching for Karn

events.summary: Jeska falls under the mental control of Leshrac, who hopes to use her Phage powers against Bolas.
events.quote: unknowingly fell under the mental control of the insidious Leshrac

events.summary: In Keld Jeska defeats Radha and takes her to use as a mana lens.
events.quote: she defeated and took Radha to use her as a mana lens for closing the rifts

events.summary: In Zhalfir Jeska closes the rift without consulting Teferi, causing the loss of the phased-out lands.
events.quote: she closed the local rift without consulting Teferi, causing the irrevocable loss of the phased-out lands

events.summary: At Yavimaya a vision from Leshrac makes Jeska immolate Multani's physical form, and she then closes the rift.
events.quote: caused Jeska to break the connection and immolate

events.summary: On Madara Leshrac ambushes Jeska, strips her Phage legacy and encases her in stone when she refuses to fight Bolas.
events.quote: Leshrac encased her in stone to keep her from interfering

events.summary: Bolas frees Jeska and tells her the Otarian rift cannot be closed.
events.quote: Bolas freed Jeska but assured her that the Otarian rift could not be closed

events.summary: Jeska, Venser and Radha teleport into the heart of the Otarian rift.
events.quote: Jeska and the two planeswalkers teleported into the heart of the rift

events.summary: Jeska shatters the image of Karona and closes all rifts in one discharge, allowing the Great Mending to begin.
events.quote: In one huge discharge of her power, she closed them all, allowing the Great Mending to begin.

events.summary: Jeska appears in a white void and is welcomed by her dead brother Kamahl, welcoming oblivion.
events.quote: she was welcomed by her beloved long-dead brother Kamahl

relations.quote: She was the sister of Kamahl
under the tutelage of her mentor Karn
Phage fought loyally for the Patriarch

relations.note: An avatar Jeska became due to a curse.
relations.quote: she briefly became an avatar named Phage the Untouchable due to a curse

relations.note: Stood with her at the final rift.
relations.quote: Venser and Radha assured her that they would stand by her
